title: Vural & Burcu — Altın Kapı
gate_prompt:
Create ONE continuous cinematic fantasy wedding-invitation shot, 10 seconds, vertical 9:16. Animate the supplied first frame and arrive naturally at the supplied final frame. The visual language is monumental ancient high fantasy: deep wet charcoal stone, refined gold inlay, dramatic volumetric sunset light, physically convincing heavy doors, photographic materials and subtle anamorphic character.

FIRST FRAME: the attached dark cave and closed arched double stone door. FINAL FRAME: the supplied open doorway looking toward a golden Mediterranean valley with ancient columns, cypresses and mountains; use its framing and composition as the destination. These are stages of the same physical doorway, not two images to dissolve between.

ACTION AND CAMERA: 0–2 seconds, a slow low dolly forward over real wet stone with tiny water ripples and a few falling cave droplets. 2–8 seconds, the SAME two massive door leaves rotate inward on their outer vertical hinges exactly once, with convincing inertia. A narrow vertical golden line widens into warm natural sunlight. Stone edges stay rigid, carvings stay attached to their surfaces, the door frame keeps the same shape and dimensions. The opening reveals the landscape through actual growing occlusion, NOT a portal swirl or image morph. 8–10 seconds, the camera gently advances to the threshold and settles into the supplied final composition, with both open door leaves visible at the sides. Clouds drift slightly and sparse dust catches the sun.

AUDIO: only restrained natural cave water drops, deep heavy stone hinge/grind, distant soft wind; the space gradually opens into airy outdoor ambience. No speech, no singing, no music, no metallic hiss, no loud explosive impacts.

One physical event in one space, stable geometry, photographic motion, realistic depth and parallax. No cuts, no repeated approach, no zoom-reset, no slideshow, no cross-dissolve, no freeze-frame, no people, no newly invented writing, no subtitles, no buttons, no watermarks. Keep highlights controlled and rich texture visible in the shadows.
envelope_prompt:
Create one continuous 10-second vertical 9:16 cinematic fantasy wedding-invitation shot. The FIRST FRAME is the supplied already OPEN ancient stone doorway framing the golden Salihli-inspired valley. Keep that same landscape, sunset direction, stone paving, and warm black-and-gold palette. The FINAL FRAME is the supplied close view of a cream paper invitation rising from a black envelope. Preserve the black envelope design visible in the final reference: textured black paper, one circular gold B/V wax seal and fine gold olive branches.

ACTION: 0–2 seconds, the camera glides gently beyond the already open doorway into the warm golden light, without opening the door again. 2–4 seconds, ONE sealed black envelope descends from above with believable mass and a short controlled fall, and comes to rest on a flat foreground stone ledge. Sparse dust rises at contact. 4–6 seconds, the camera moves closer; a restrained warm glow travels along the gold wax seal, the seal splits subtly once, and the upper triangular flap hinges open along its actual paper fold. 6–10 seconds, ONE rigid cream invitation card slides smoothly upward out of the open envelope under a visible gentle golden magical lift. The camera follows and settles on the final reference composition: readable cream textured card, small elegant B/V monogram, the original MANİSA · SALİHLİ location line and fine sepia ancient-ruin illustration, with the black envelope still supporting it below. All paper remains rigid and proportionate; the card fits inside this exact envelope before emerging.

CINEMATOGRAPHY: one motivated fluid dolly and close approach, realistic lens breathing, shallow depth of field that resolves onto the card, rich photographic surface detail, controlled highlights, a sparse few gold dust particles. High-fantasy magic is delicate and physical, never a glowing screen or VFX explosion. Avoid floating debris and shiny plastic textures. No new people or hands, no image slideshow, no dissolves, no cuts, no duplicate envelopes, no repeated opening. Preserve the supplied monogram and lettering shapes without adding new lettering, dates, names, captions, controls or watermark.

AUDIO: natural soft wind throughout, one gentle paper-on-stone landing, a quiet wax crack, tactile paper folds and a soft card slide. No speech, no singing, no music, no electronic or metallic scratching. End calmly with open airy ambience.
event_details: User-supplied references name Manisa–Salihli. No unconfirmed date, time or venue is printed.
